title: WORKSHEET 10
subject: Present Perfect Tense
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 10: Present Perfect Tense

sections.instruction: Write a suitable sentence using the PRESENT PERFECT TENSE: (Example: Ann’s hair was dirty. Now it’s clean. (wash) → Ann has washed her hair.)

questions.prompt: Tom was 80 kg. Now he’s 70. (lose weight)
acceptedAnswers: Tom has lost weight.
He has lost weight.
He's lost weight.
Tom has lost 10 kg.
questions.explanation: present perfect: past action with a result now

He's broken his leg.

She's gone on holiday to France.
questions.explanation: has gone = went and is still there

questions.prompt: Mr. Hill was in Canada last week. He’s back in London now. (be)

He has been to Canada.
He's been to Canada.

sections.instruction: Rewrite the following sentences twice, using SINCE and FOR. Write both sentences: (Example: I haven’t seen you. (Christmas / 3 days) → I haven’t seen you since Christmas. I haven’t seen you for 3 days.)

questions.prompt: We’ve been here. (an hour / 4 o’clock)
acceptedAnswers: We have been here since 4 o'clock. We have been here for an hour.
We've been here since 4 o'clock. We've been here for an hour.
We have been here for an hour. We have been here since 4 o'clock.
We've been here for an hour. We've been here since 4 o'clock.
questions.explanation: since + point in time; for + period

questions.prompt: She hasn’t spoken to me. (2 weeks / last week)
acceptedAnswers: She hasn't spoken to me since last week. She hasn't spoken to me for 2 weeks.
She hasn't spoken to me for 2 weeks. She hasn't spoken to me since last week.
questions.explanation: since + point in time; for + period

questions.prompt: They’ve lived in this street. (1970 / a long time)
acceptedAnswers: They have lived in this street since 1970. They have lived in this street for a long time.
They've lived in this street since 1970. They've lived in this street for a long time.
They have lived in this street for a long time. They have lived in this street since 1970.
They've lived in this street for a long time. They've lived in this street since 1970.
questions.explanation: since + point in time; for + period

questions.prompt: I haven’t had time to do it. (last Monday / a few days)
acceptedAnswers: I haven't had time to do it since last Monday. I haven't had time to do it for a few days.
I haven't had time to do it for a few days. I haven't had time to do it since last Monday.
questions.explanation: since + point in time; for + period

questions.prompt: We haven’t bought a new one. (ages / many years)
acceptedAnswers: We haven't bought a new one for ages. We haven't bought a new one for many years.
We haven't bought a new one for many years. We haven't bought a new one for ages.
questions.explanation: ages and many years are periods: both take for
